fields.description: Coastline Beach Residences comprises four towers on Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. Its apartments and duplexes range from compact one-bedroom homes to split-level residences with yards and balconies. The developer’s furnishing promise applies specifically to Tower A.

overview: A duplex places its rooms on two connected levels. Total saleable area includes outdoor space; compare the actual enclosed rooms and circulation rather than relying on one headline size.
research.locationNote: On Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. Beach, lagoon and park orientations vary by tower and unit.
research.priceNote: The official page displays AED 1.86m subject to inventory. Property Finder retains an AED 1.21m launch reference, rounded to 1.2m in its headline. These do not establish a live available unit.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder gives 60% during construction and 40% handover. A separate booking percentage is not stated and has not been inferred. No current primary instalment calendar was found.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder reports September 2028, displayed as Q3 2028. This remains an estimate, not a guaranteed contractual date.
